title: Synthetic NDA acceptance fixture
notice: Entirely fictional. Software acceptance fixture, not legal advice or a firm-approved policy.
paragraphs: This mutual non-disclosure agreement is between Example Alpha Ltd and Example Beta Ltd for evaluating a fictional collaboration.
Each party may use confidential information only to evaluate the collaboration.
Confidentiality lasts five years from disclosure.
Confidential information excludes information already public or independently developed without use of the disclosing party's information.
The recipient may disclose information required by law without notifying the disclosing party.

rules.standardPosition: Use only to evaluate the collaboration.
Confidentiality lasts three years from disclosure.
fallbacks: Confidentiality lasts four years from disclosure.

rules.standardPosition: The recipient may disclose information required by law after giving prompt notice to the disclosing party where legally permitted.
Return or destroy confidential information on request, subject to legal retention obligations.
